checks: Information class is nonempty; every constant-L quadratic witness satisfies the entire paid lower support and q(a)<=U precisely on the stated untruncated derivative interval
One common derivative witness maximizes the announced random law before its draw; expected support is sigma_I(EZ), with the exact nonnegative L Var(Z)/2 term
Implemented discrepancy extremizer is one allowed Borel function, produces delta Pr(Z!=0), and assigns zero penalty to exact retention
Conditioning on replacement probability gives the minimax lower bound without invalid sup/expectation interchange; zero-gain, equality and zero-discrepancy cases are covered
The abstract information-class sharpness is explicitly distinguished from fixed investment primitives, rounded finite candidates and candidate qualification
Dynamic gain subtraction uses updated action with same incumbent continuation, positive dual slack and infimum orientation
Risk supremum nonattainment is handled by approximation; finite-penalty nonempty set and relaxed infinite penalties are covered by stated domain/support hypotheses
Lower-penalty operators are bounded, monotone, concave, cash invariant, normalized and nonexpansive; measurability is assumed on the complete needed domain
Finite-horizon original-policy gain and subsolution results follow by backward induction, with beta>=0 including zero
Finite complete-menu occupation objective has correct beta weights; feasible flows are upper bounds on the minimum, while verified subsolutions give lower certificates
Stationary beta<1 contractions operate on all bounded measurable functions; existence, uniqueness, monotone uniform iteration and subsolution limits are justified
All-state certification and unchanged original objective/information are explicit; finite sample checks and current two-date numerical allowances are not promoted to general multistage claims
reviewer_role: separate evidence/custody agent, mathematical read-through of actual current source
scope: Full current proposition/theorem assumptions, statements and proofs; this is a new source review, not restoration of a lost earlier review or an experiment.
